author: Kuhn & Rueß GmbH
description: LDAP attribute sync plugin "Contact group membership (strip characters from CN)". Works like the builtin contact group membership plugin, but removes configurable characters (default "$") from the CN of the LDAP group before comparing it case-insensitively with the contact group names. This way LDAP groups like "GRP$Admins" can be mapped to the contact group "GRPAdmins". Supports nested groups and groups from other LDAP connections. After installing, run "omd restart ui-job-scheduler".
name: ldap_contactgroups_strip
title: LDAP contact group membership with stripped group names
